name: Response Informatics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1996, Response Informatics Ltd is a global IT Enterprise Automation, Consulting & Software Solutions Provider company
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company started with Product Development, Designing Digital Solutions, Global Staffing Solutions, Management Consulting and at present provides solutions to several other sectors, such as software development 
and Enterprise software, Block chain, 
Artificial intelligence, Data analytics, 
Robotic Process Automation, Internet 
of Things, etc.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -4.92%
